enumeration.source: GeckoTerminal token-pools API, fully paginated by exact token address through a short terminal page; Pendle Core v2 markets/all fully paginated (808 records) and filtered by exact underlying asset ID.
enumeration.live_venue_count_basis: Swap pools were not execution-tested and carry is_live=null. Pendle liveness is established only from maturity relative to enumeration.as_of.
enumeration.completeness: Complete enumeration of pools returned by the named indexes for all nine declared chains and exact chain-specific addresses, including dust and suspicious pools. This is not proof that an unindexed on-chain pool does not exist.
enumeration.empty_chain_note: Every requested chain is explicitly classified; not-configured is reserved for an actual source/transport failure and is never interpreted as no venue.

methodology.tvl_semantics: tvl_usd is source-reported pool TVL, not executable depth. Values are not summed across overlapping or composable pools to claim exit capacity.
methodology.nav_ratio_note: sUSDe/USDe is balanced around the ERC-4626 NAV ratio (approximately 1.251 USDe per sUSDe at enumeration), not 1:1; treating balances as a 1:1 stable pair would misstate balance because sUSDe accrues yield.
methodology.curve_named_pool_note: The two load-bearing pool claims from the commissioning report were audited explicitly. The Curve USDC/sUSDe pool exists but is dust-sized in the source snapshot. No exact Curve USDe/sUSDe pool was returned. The often-cited 0x4b5E... pool is Synth sUSD/sUSDe, not USDe/sUSDe; both GeckoTerminal token metadata and on-chain coins(0) resolve its counter-token to 0x57ab... (Synth sUSD).

sUSDe_USDe.verification: GeckoTerminal included-token metadata plus Ethereum eth_call coins(0) and coins(1).

methodology.pendle_note: Pendle markets are enumerated with maturity: 2 live and 15 matured at enumeration.as_of. Matured markets are excluded from current live venue counts; residual TVL is not executable depth.
methodology.slippage_convention: not_applicable: this payload publishes no cost, slippage, ladder, crossing, or score fields. If a future DexTracker cost is added, slippage_bps means total and slippage_bps_debiased means marginal; PegTracker publishes marginal.
